en: "Thanks, Mig.{w}Now then, you guys!{w}What do you say we do the usual?"{w}
note: "the usual" = their recurring fight with the player party (a battle follows). Addressed to the player party.

en: "You're as good as ever!"{w}
"I won't lose next time!"{w}
"Off with ALL your heads!"{w}
note: Maniron's beheading obsession (kubi-hane). Said after the fight, aimed at the player party.

en: "Mighty bloodthirsty, ain't it..."{w}
note: Mokero's -yansu lackey dialect, dropped-g/"ain't" register as in slice_05.

en: "Ah, the folly of youth, I suppose..."{w}
note: Korbitz, old-man register.

en: "You'd better look forward to next time, got it?{w}We'll be even stronger by then."{w}
note: Who "will be stronger" is not stated; "we" (Yamuru's whole party) inferred from the group farewell. Could be "I".

en:
"That's right!
Well then, see you around!"{w}

note: kono yarou kept at full strength ("you bastard"). kubi hane-sokoneta = "missed my chance to behead".

en: Chute{w}
note: Trap caption: chute to a lower floor (same family as Pit).

en: But you are floating in midair{w}
note: Levitation negates the chute/pit; used by both scripts. No final period, like the source caption.

en: Pit{w}
# Light spell active
note: op029 = debug print (cf. VICTORY_COUNT rows in slice_01); probably never shown. Box glyph replaced by "#" for ASCII.

en: # No light spell
note: op029 debug print; see 412.

en: {0A:0003:0000} sensed a presence{w}
note: Insert = party member name. Caption style without period, like the source.

en: Secret Door{w}
There is a locked door.
Open it?
Who will pick the lock?
The lock opened.
The lock did not open.
There's a switch. Press it?
The switch turned off.{w}
The switch turned on.{w}
There's a ladder. Climb up?
There's a ladder. Climb down?
You are inside the stone
note: Classic Wizardry "ishi no naka ni iru" (teleported into a wall). Worded to match the joke in slice_05 row 333 ("*INSIDE THE STONE*"). No period, like the source caption.

en: It looks like you can board the ship by going down this ladder.{w}
Board the ship?
It looks like you can climb up to the shore with this ladder.{w}
Climb up?

As you stand before the door,
it begins to open with a rumble that shakes the ground.{w}

There is a tightly sealed door.
There is nothing that looks like a keyhole.{w}
"Welcooome!{w}A tavern is like a home for adventurers, so don't be shy -- make yourselves comfy!"{w}
"By the way, shouldn't you be heading to the castle?{w}A guard came by earlier and said there'd be news about the Proclamation soon."{w}
note: okure = the Proclamation (glossary).

en: "Oh, so you guys got one of those compass thingies too!"{w}{p}"So you're gonna use it to find the site of the legendary Stairway of Light, huh?{w}Go get 'em, rookie adventurers!!"{w}
note: New term: Stairway of Light (hikari no kaidan); atochi = the site where it once stood. "compass thingies" keeps Mucha's "something called a compass".

en: "I heard! You found the site of the Stairway of Light!{w}Congrats! Ba-boom!"{w}{p}"Adventurers from my very own tavern getting a royal command from the King -- that makes me so happy!"{w}{p}"Sounds like that just means there's more stuff to search for now, but I know you guys can find it all.{w}Good luck!"{w}
note: dondoon = "Ba-boom" (pilot). chokumei = royal command.

en:
Chop, chop -- Mucha is happily slicing vegetables
with a crisp, cheerful rhythm.{w}She strikes up a conversation as she preps.{w}
note: Mucha is female per glossary, so "She".

en: "You adventurers, y'know...{w}you're kinda weird, huh?{w}Ah, no, I mean that in a good way, of course!"{w}{p}"When people come back covered in blood, normally they'd worry about their bodies first, right?{w}But with you it's all 'Appraise!' 'Split the loot!'..."{w}{p}"'Before you start fighting over the 1 GP that won't split evenly, wipe your nosebleeds, you lot!' -- I can't count how many times I've thought that."{w}
note: kantei = item appraisal; yamawake = splitting the loot. Inner Japanese quote rendered with single quotes.

en: "But maybe it's because I've been watching adventurers like you since I was little.{w}Your weird vibe -- I kinda like it, y'know?"{w}{p}"So come by as often as you want!{w}Once you've eaten your fill, tell me all about your fun adventures!"{w}
note: kimitachi here = adventurers in general (she has watched them since childhood), hence "adventurers like you". kirai ja nai (litotes) -> "I kinda like it".

en: "Welcome! You must be hungry, huh?{w}I'll get some hot food ready for you, so hang on a sec!"{w}
The tavern doesn't seem to be open yet.{w}
"...Hup, there we go."{w}
Mucha is putting up a notice on the wall.{w}The notice reads:{w}

{0E}*                        RE: Mixing Good and Evil                        *
*                        alignments in one party                        *
*             By popular demand, Mucha proposes:             *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*                 Bring me Makana Essence from                  *
*                     the Leanmakana Mountains                      *
*                  and I just might think about it!                   *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*                     Bring back lots of it, okay!                     *
*                                                                                       *
*                                                                      Ba-boom  *{0F}{w}
note: Notice: 3 pages x 3 lines framed by *, padded with spaces to about 368 px (measured with tools/text_build.text_width) to mirror the full-width Japanese frame; "Ba-boom" right-aligned like the source. kangaete agenaku mo nai -> "I just might think about it". New term: Makana Essence.

en:
"Oh, welcome!{w}So? What do you think of this notice?
If I do say so myself, it's a brilliant idea!"{w}{p}"If you guys want to make a mixed party too, bring me some Makana Essence from the plants that grow in the Leanmakana Mountains, okay?"{w}
note: konsei party = party mixing Good and Evil members -> "mixed party".

en: "Haah...{w}I might finally get to eat it again after all this time... Kufufu~"{w}
note: Sigh of anticipation; object (the essence / what it makes) implied -> "it". Giggle kept; note mark -> "~".

en: "If you guys want to make a mixed party too, bring me some Makana Essence from the plants that grow in the Leanmakana Mountains, okay?"{w}
note: Same wording as page 2 of row 445.

en: "Welcooome.{w}...Huh?"{w}

"This scent...!{w}Hands up, everyone!
Inventory check, ba-boom!!"{w}
note: Addressed to the whole party -> "everyone".

en: Mucha brings her nose close to your belongings and starts searching for something.{w}
"Sniff, sniff... Th-this scent is...!{w}Makana Essence, fouuund!"{w}
Mucha found the Makana Essence.{w}
note: Source is passive ("it got found"); the finder is Mucha from the previous rows, so made active.

en: "You brought it back for me, didn't you?{w}Thank you!"{w}
Hand over the Makana Essence?

"You folks, I built on a room just for you folks.{w}Here, the stable's bigger... What's with that look?{w}{p}Take a good look, now --
the Alchemy Storage got bigger too, y'know..."{w}
note: nanja? = reacting to the party's unimpressed face. Page 2 continues the same quote, so no opening quote (as in the source). New term: Alchemy Storage (renkin souko; PLACE_NM slot max 16 chars).

en: {0E}              * You can now store up to 30 items *{0F}{w}
note: Centered with spaces to mirror the source frame.

en: "Ho ho ho, business is boomin' thanks to you folks.{w}So I added on again... Yep, the stable. What of it?{w}The Alchemy Storage got bigger along with it, eh..."{w}{p}"You'll just go causin' explosions anyway, ain'tcha...?{w}Then all the more reason I can't go expandin' the inn itself... can I... eh, old girl..."{w}
note: sono toori = Zeppo answering the party's unspoken "the stable again?". baa-san ya = Zeppo addressing his late wife: "old girl" when addressed, "the missus" when referred to (rows 466-472).

en: {0E}              * You can now store up to 50 items *{0F}{w}

"Ohh... welcome, welcome...{w}You folks sure are makin' a name for yourselves...{w}Here, I made the stable even bigger for ya."{w}{p}"With it this big, alchemy oughta be easier, I reckon...{w}...and it'll make things easier on me too.{w}Hm? What's that? Did I say somethin'?"{w}
{0E}              * You can now store up to 99 items *{0F}{w}

note: owakai no -> "young'uns".

en:
"What a bother.{w}Do I really gotta change the sheets every time?"{w}{p}"With the stable,
all it takes is stirrin' the straw around a bit."{w}{p}"Listen, young'uns.{w}Economy, Royal, whatever ya ask for -- I ain't makin' up any beds, y'hear? That's fine, right?"{w}
note: Economy / Royal = inn room grades (katakana in source); must match the inn menu once it is translated.

gousei renkin = "synthesis alchemy"; rendo (ore refinement value) = "grade" (uncertain, see report). Last page has no closing quote, as in the source: row 464 re-shows it in {0E}..{0F} and finishes the sentence.
{0E}..{0F} repeats the last page of row 463 verbatim ({w} -> \n), as in the source.
tohoho = rueful sigh. Note mark -> "~".

en: "Maybe I oughta just quit runnin' this inn...{w}Would the missus be mad at me from the other side, I wonder..."{w}
"Stayin' over again, are ya?{w}You sure do keep poppin' in and out in dribs and drabs.{w}No use livin' your life in such a rush."{w}{p}"Kwah kwah kwah!"{w}
note: Laugh "Kwah kwah kwah!" as in the pilot. | ED: 'bit by bit' read oddly; chimachima = piecemeal comings and goings -> 'in dribs and drabs'.

en:
"...You there. See that landscape paintin' over there?{w}My late wife painted that, y'know."{w}{p}"The anniversary of her passin' is comin' up soon.{w}She was a real nag while she was alive, but...
I'd like to at least give her a flower."{w}{p}"'Crystal Flower' -- that was the missus's favorite flower..."{w}{p}"By rights, I oughta go pick it myself,
but I can't leave the inn empty.{w}Besides, I'm gettin' on in years, ya know?"{w}{p}"Sorry to ask, but could ya go to the Crystal Labyrinth
and fetch me a Crystal Flower?"{w}
note: meinichi = anniversary of a death. Page 2 lacks a closing quote before page 3 opens a new one -- kept as in the source (likely a source typo; proofreader may add it). New terms: Crystal Flower (suishouka), Crystal Labyrinth (suishou no meikyuu; DGN_NAME slot max 18). | PROOF: closing quote added at end of page 2 (page 3 opens a new quote; not continued in a later row).

en:
"In return... I've kept this hidden till now, but...{w}besides the stable, there's also another... What?
You already know about it?"{w}
note: Zeppo was about to reveal the Alchemy Storage; the party already knows.

en: "Sorry to ask, but could ya go to the Crystal Labyrinth and fetch me a Crystal Flower?"{w}

"Ohh, I've been waitin' for ya.
Old girl, we made it in time for your anniversary."{w}
note: Addressed to his late wife (baa-san). "anniversary" = meinichi, set up in row 468.

en: "This oughta make the missus happy, I reckon... Thank ya kindly."{w}
"Oh, that's right.{w}Here, over there... feel free to use that space however ya like."{w}
"That there's called the Alchemy Storage.{w}You folks have done a lot for me,{w}so from now on, use it as much as ya like..."{w}
{0E}                  * The storage fee is now 0 GP *{0F}{w}
note: souko riyouryou = storage usage fee.
haikara = old-fashioned word for "trendy/Western" -> "fancy". Economy = room grade, see 462.

en: "HEYYY! What d'ya think you're doin'!!"{w}
"No explosions!{w}
note: Rows 478-480 build one shouted sentence; each next row re-shows the previous text in {0E}..{0F}. Synced with slice_07 row 480, which starts {0E}"No explosions!\nThat's what I told ya!{0F}.

en:
{0E}"No explosions!{0F}
That's what I told ya!{w}
note: Echo of row 478 ({w} -> \n), as in the source. Synced with slice_07 row 480.

Third step of the 478/479/480 build-up (rows 478-479 are in slice_06). The {0E}..{0F} part repeats the two earlier rows, so slice_06 should use 478 = '"No explosions!{w}' and 479 = '{0E}"No explosions!{0F}\nThat's what I told ya!{w}' or this row must be re-synced. BWOOOOOAAARGH = Zeppo (a dragon, per pilot) roaring/breathing fire mid-sentence.

en: You got chewed out...{w}

"Leave every last coin ya got and get out,
ya fools!!"{w}
note: Kono bakamono addressed to the party; pluralised to 'fools'.

en:
{0E}
              * No Money, Yeah!! *{0F}{w}
note: Source banner already English (full-width); converted to ASCII. Banners centred with leading spaces only -- check rendering.
Classic Wizardry trap exclamation (oootto!).

en:
{0E}
              * You are in bliss *{0F}{w}
note: Parody of the Wizardry 'you are inside the stone' message (ishi no naka ni iru -> shiawase no naka ni iru). Kept the 'You are in ...' frame so the joke survives.

en: Offer something to {12:0001:01BB}?
note: {12:0001:01BB} = runtime insert, referent unknown (item/character name from the inn event).

en:
Please select 3 items.
(The items will be lost.){w}

As you slept nestled close together,
your hand touched an Amulet of Life.{w}
note: Who nestles with whom is not stated (yorisotte nemuru); kept impersonal. Amulet of Life = new item name (ITEM.CSV:388, max 20).

en: "You folks keep bringing me all sorts of things, so I was sorting through my stock and this turned up.{w}I can't say whether it'll be any use on your adventures..."{w}{p}"How you use it is up to you.{w}I'll put it out on the shelf, so give it a try if you like."{w}
{0E}   * Great History of Crestard now in stock *{0F}{w}
note: Great History of Crestard = new item name (ITEM.CSV:187; 25 chars > item-name max 20, item table will need a short form).

en: "Looks like you folks have been making quite a name for yourselves.{w}I can tell just from the stuff you bring in.{w}At that rate, your travel costs can't be anything to sneeze at, can they?"{w}{p}"Tell you what -- for you lot, I'll throw in a little extra.{w}Nobody ever had trouble from having too much money, right?{w}You're helping me out too, so don't be shy."{w}
note: iro tsukeru = pay a bit over the going rate for their goods (cf. banner 493).

en: {0E}      * The shop now pays more for items *{0F}{w}
note: kaitori kakaku = price the shop pays the party; phrased from the player's side to avoid buy/sell confusion.

en: "...Hey, could you take a look at this for me?{w}It isn't just my eyes, is it...?{w}I swear the writing changes every time I open it."{w}{p}"When did I even buy something like this...?{w}...Doesn't seem to carry any weird curse, at least.{w}Well, I'll put it out anyway, so do what you like with it."{w}
{0E}     * Book of the Next Age now in stock *{0F}{w}

"You folks really are something.
People come from all over just to buy my goods.{w}Nearly every rare thing I've got is something you brought in."{w}{p}"I used to worry about your travel money, but that's not a problem anymore, is it? So how about this: this time, purely as one trading partner to another, I'll raise the prices I pay you."{w}{p}"Not a bad deal, is it?{w}I meant to be the one looking after you at first, but somewhere along the way it got turned around. Call it my thanks."{w}
{0E}   * The shop now pays much more for items *{0F}{w}

"...Yep. Just as I thought.
Have you folks noticed?{w}This shop now has goods from all over the continent."{w}{p}"At first I figured I was just mistaken, but when I checked, every last thing was here.{w}Took me a good few days, mind you..."{w}{p}"...I bet he'd be glad too.{w}Big shots like you, coming out of this little shop...{w}Let me thank you on my husband's behalf. ...Thank you."{w}
note: ano hito = Gia's late husband (danna, cf. row 507), so 'he' is settled.

en: {0E}  * Encyclopedia of All Things now in stock *{0F}{w}
note: Encyclopedia of All Things = new item name (script: banbutsu hyakka jiten; ITEM.CSV:189 spells it with a different kanji, same item).

en:
"The selection's nothing special,
but I think it'll help you on your first adventure."{w}

"There's no need to rush.{w}Once you've prepared and shopped to your satisfaction,
then you can set out."{w}

"Got anyone in your party who uses spells?{w}If you do, you'd better equip them with something like a Fire Magic Seal to raise their elemental attack."{w}{p}"You can think of a spell's power as being decided by elemental attack."{w}
note: Fire Magic Seal = new item name (ITEM.CSV:358, en_no maiin; glossary Magic Seal). zokusei kougekiryoku -> 'elemental attack': align with the status-screen UI term once it exists.

en: "Have you got a Bishop in your party?{w}I can appraise things for you too, but if one of your own can do it, you'll save on appraisal fees."{w}{p}"Adventurers just starting out are pretty strapped for cash, right?{w}You've got to be as efficient as you can."{w}
"Phew..."{w}
Gia is pressing a hand to her eyes.{w}
"This job is murder on the eyes."{w}
"...My late husband was an adventurer.{w}I'd look over what he brought home and sell it to make ends meet, and before I knew it, I was running an item shop. Ha ha."{w}

"Unlike me, Toner's the lively type.{w}Being curious is all well and good,
but I worry Toner will end up ruining their health."{w}
note: Toner's gender is unknown in the glossary (pilot uses 'my kid'/'they'); kept neutral throughout.

en: There's no one here.{w}
"Ow, ow, ow...{w}Honestly, I'm supposed to be a veteran. How pathetic."{w}
Gia came in injured, with Toner supporting her.{w}{p}Her hand must have slipped during an appraisal.{w}Gia had a bandage wrapped around her leg.{w}
note: ashi = leg or foot; 'leg' chosen.

en: "Oh, welcome.{w}Sorry you have to see me like this... Ngh!"{w}
"Is the wound deep?"{w}

"I'll be fine.{w}They say if I keep it bandaged and take it easy,
it'll heal in about one turn of the moon."{w}
note: tsuki ga hitomeguri = roughly a month; kept the moon image because Toner echoes it in 516.

en: "One turn..."{w}
"...What are we going to do about Emera?"{w}
note: Refers to Toner's regular checkup at Emera's house (explained in row 532).

en: "...Should I go by myself?"{w}
"Going alone would be too dangerous, surely.{w}Monsters aren't the only danger in the mountains, you know?"{w}
"Maybe we should ask Fena about it.{w}Ngh... I need to sit down a sec.{w}An adventurer with time to spare... Is there anyone like that, I wonder..."{w}
"An adventurer with time to spare...{w}
note: Row 523 repeats this text inside {0E}..{0F}; keep both identical.

en:
{0E}"An adventurer with time to spare...{0F}
Eep!"{w}
note: hau! = startled gasp as Toner notices the party.

en: Your eyes met Toner's.{w}
note: me ga atte shimatta: subject restored as the party and Toner (Toner spoke the line before).

en: "Mom, these people look like they've got nothing to do!"{w}
"Don't say such silly things, honestly.{w}Sorry about that -- just pay no attention."{w}
"*Staaaaaare*...{w}You'll take it on... won't you...?"{w}

For some reason, looking into Toner's adorable eyes,
you get the eerie feeling you'll be killed if you refuse.{w}

Without even checking what it was,
you ended up accepting Toner's request.{w}
"Honestly, you and your..."{w}
note: anta tte ko wa mou... = exasperated scolding of her own child, trailing off.

en: "Toner has... well, it's complicated, but Toner needs to go to Emera's house in the Leanmakana Mountains regularly for a health checkup."{w}{p}"If you'd help us, I'd be really grateful, but..."{w}
note: Repeated 'Toner' instead of a pronoun to stay gender-neutral.

en:
"Okay then, let's go together!
I'm counting on you!"{w}

"Ah, hey..."{w}{p}"Honestly...{w}Sorry to ask this of you,
but please look after Toner for me, okay?"{w}
"Welcome.{w}Where does Toner get that pushiness from, I wonder...{w}Sorry to ask, but please look after Toner for me, okay?"{w}
"So nothing was wrong this time either?"{w}
"Yep, no need to worry!"{w}
"Thank goodness..."{w}
"You make such a big fuss every single time."{w}
"And what's wrong with that..."{w}

When you returned to the shop,
Gia was gently hugging Toner.{w}

"You folks...{w}Thank you for looking after Toner. Really, thank you."{w}{p}"This child was born under unusual circumstances.{w}Just seeing my kid grow up healthy like this
is all it takes to make me happy."{w}
note: umare ga tokushu = unusual birth; detail not explained here, kept vague.

en: "Thank you so much, once again!"{w}
"I'm so glad..."{w}

"Welcome.{w}How's the adventuring? Going well?"{w}{p}"If there's anything I can help with,
just say the word, okay?"{w}

"Have you been to the castle yet?
I may not look it, but I'm confident in my skills.{w}So go and adventure with peace of mind!"{w}

"Oh, you've received the Compass.{w}Then go forth and adventure to your heart's content.
Our temple looks forward to your patronage."{w}
note: Compass = key item from the castle (cf. EVENT_TEXT 'use the compass'); capitalised as an item.

en: "Hello, come right in! Welcome to Rust Temple!{w}Our temple handles everything from corpse retrieval to resurrection.{w}Adventurers are most welcome here!"{w}
note: Greeting matches the pilot's rendering of the same phrase (pilot row 340).

en:
"Hello, come right in! Welcome to Rust Temple!{w}Our temple offers a whole range of services
to support you all on a comfortable journey!"{w}
"Safety and peace of mind can be bought with money -- up to a point.{w}However, most regrettably, beyond that point, money is no guarantee............"{w}
"That's where WE come in!"{w}
note: soko de! = sales-pitch pivot ('and so!'); rendered with the idiomatic pitch line.

en: "All manner of treatments, even if you can't cast Priest spells!{w}Corpse retrieval, with no risk of your rescuers becoming casualties too!{w}And resurrection on your behalf, with our temple's proudly high success rate!"{w}
note: niji sounan = a second disaster striking the rescue party.

en:
"These are services found only at our temple,
which no one else could ever hope to imitate.{w}So whenever your party gets wiped out -- in moderation............"{w}
note: hodohodo ni zenmetsu = deliberately absurd 'wiped out moderately'; the joke is kept.

en: "Be sure to come to our temple."{w}

"Hello, come right in! Welcome to Rust Temple!{w}Our temple offers a whole range of... What's the matter?{w}This is business. Without a sales pitch,
there are no sales--"{w}{p}"Of course, life is precious.{w}
note: Row ends mid-quote by design; row 556 repeats the last sentence inside {0E}..{0F}.

en:
{0E}"Of course, life is precious.{0F}
...But so is money."{w}
"I don't intend to be ashamed of that,{w}because it's the truth, whatever anyone says."{w}

"Hello, come right in! Welcome to Rust...{w}Ah, it's you folks... How are things?{w}...You're adventurers, if I remember correctly...?"{w}{p}"...Actually, I have a bit of a problem."{w}{p}"Our temple looks after a graveyard for the nameless dead
in the Crotoa City Ruins,{w}and lately wild dogs have been ravaging it."{w}
note: Crotoa City Ruins = new place name (Kurotoa shigai atochi; DGN_NAME.CSV:21). mumei bochi -> 'graveyard for the nameless dead' (unmarked graves); slice_08/EVENT_TEXT refer to the same place.

en:
"Our temple's after-sales service has to be flawless,
even after death!"{w}
note: shigo no afutaa saabisu pun; 'after-sales service' should be reused in slice_08 rows 561-563 (perfect after-sales service as the reward).

en: "...That's how it ought to be, but I'm ashamed to admit that unless it's something healing or Dispel works on, I'm just hopeless at dealing with it......"{w}{p}"If it's not too much trouble, could you go chase them off for me?"{w}
note: 'them' = the stray dogs desecrating the nameless cemetery (slice_07 row 558). 'healing or Dispel works on' = undead; Dispel is the class ability name (JOB_EX [JP]). | ACC: "...nanodesu ga" follows 559 (service must be flawless) -> "That's how it ought to be, but", not "That's the situation".

en: "As for your reward: flawless after-sales service! That's my offer.{w}
note: [JP] kept as 'after-sales service' (sales-pitch joke for a money-grubbing priest; echoes slice_07 row 559 [JP] -- align that row). Rows 561/562/563 share this sentence word-for-word because 562 re-displays 561 inside {0E}..{0F} and 563 is a variant of the same line.

en:
{0E}"As for your reward: flawless after-sales service! That's my offer.{0F}
I'm counting on you, all right?"{w}{p}"I can't let this temple's reputation take a hit."{w}{p}"Oh, and please keep this matter between us.{w}...I am 'Hardy the Money-Grubber,' after all."{w}
note: 'Hardy the Money-Grubber' as in pilot row 342.

en:
"As for your reward: flawless after-sales service! That's my offer.
I'm counting on you, all right?"{w}{p}"If the dead can't even rest in peace... this temple's good name will be tarnished."{w}
"Come right in, welcome to Rust Tem...{w}

{0E}"Come right in, welcome to Rust Tem...{0F}
Oh! It's you!{w}Thank you so much!"{w}
"...By the way, are any of you hurt?"{w}
"No, no, you've truly saved me.{w}If I can't even look after the place where they sleep, it would affect the number of corpse-- er, customers brought in to us."{w}
note: Source: Hardy almost says 'corpses' ([JP]) and corrects to 'customers'; kept the slip.

en: "...Let me see... Money is important.{w}There's a surprising amount you can do with money, you know.{w}A warm meal, a bed where you won't freeze... things like that."{w}

"But you could also say we're prisoners of money.{w}So at the very least, once people die, whatever their money,{w}I'd like them to rest in peace... That's what I believe."{w}{p}"...That wasn't like me at all, was it?
Please forget I said it."{w}
note: 'prisoners of money': subject unstated in source; rendered as general 'we' (people in general), which the next sentence about the dead supports.

en:
"Now then... about your reward...
I've given it a lot of thought since then."{w}

"The truth is... the other day, even though it's a nameless cemetery, a bereaved family came to visit -- who knows how they tracked it down.{w}And, well... they actually thanked me..."{w}{p}"Then they donated a huge supply of medicine the deceased had left behind... Combined with our own stockpile, there's no way we could ever use it all."{w}{p}"So last night, I quietly dropped it all off at Kembeck's Shop.{w}
note: 'a bereaved family': the family of someone buried there; number/gender unspecified, kept as 'a bereaved family'.

en:
{0E}"So last night, I quietly dropped it all off at Kembeck's Shop.{0F}
...I do have a reputation as a money-grubber to keep up, after all."{w}
note: Joke: he did it secretly because a known miser can't be seen giving things away.

en: "I'm sure it's lined up on the shelves by now.{w}Please, make good use of it.{w}Think of it as an advance on that reward."{w}

note: Item names are proposals (ITEM.CSV 420/415/416, 16-char limit, not yet translated): [JP] Full Heal Potion (full HP), [JP] Paralysis Cure, [JP] Nightdew Lozenge (cures Silence). Must be synced with the ITEM.CSV translation. Here {0E}..{0F} wraps a fresh notice, not a re-display.

Proposed item names (ITEM.CSV 417/418/419): [JP] Calming Herb (cures Confusion), [JP] First Love Gem (cures Charm; 'First Love Flower Crystal' is 25 chars, over the 16-char item limit), [JP] Stone-Cure Water (cures Stone). Sync with ITEM.CSV.
The party's answer (nobody dead) happens between pages; 'Did I say something odd?' reacts to the party's look at a bishop being glad of no business.

en: You offered a silent prayer.{w}
Strange Bookmarks tucked into your adventure: {0B:0003:0057}.{w}{p}It seems that by praying, you could remove one of them.{w}
note: [JP] = 'Strange Bookmark' (ITEM_PRIZ.CSV:20 name, max 18). Sentence rebuilt as 'X: {n}' so it reads correctly for any count, including 1.

en: Remove one Strange Bookmark?
Who will pay?
Not enough money.{w}
note: dupes=6: kept as a generic system line without a subject so it fits every payer/shop.

en: "You wish to perform the Rite of Flux?"{w}{p}"......{w}My predecessor told me that rite is not something to be done lightly."{w}{p}"If you truly insist, I will perform it, but......"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Rite of Flux' (new term; also HELP_TEXT 256/284/285 menu label).

en: The Rite of Flux is a ritual that randomly relocates the Key Items and such that you have not yet obtained.{w}{p}This cannot be undone, so please be careful.{w}
note: Source literally 'the current state cannot be restored' -> 'this cannot be undone'. | ACC: kichouhin = glossary "Key Item"; "nado" (and such) restored.

en: Perform the Rite of Flux?
"Just to be sure, I have to ask..."{w}
"You truly wish to perform the Rite of Flux?"
note: data row is the yes/no prompt question, not a choice; 45 chars. Short form if needed: '"Truly perform the Rite of Flux?"'.

en: "Very well.{w}The cost will be an offering of 100,000 GP."{w}
note: [JP] written 'GP' as in pilot row 281.

en: Will you pay?
"Then let us begin the rite."{w}
The Key Items you have not yet obtained scattered once more to places throughout the world.{w}
note: ACC: kichouhin = glossary "Key Item" (matches 583).

en: "May this rite bring light to the road that lies before you all..."{w}
"Everyone, it seems your offering is... a little short."{w}
"I see. That may well be a wise decision.{w}Trials are not something to avoid, but something to face."{w}{p}"May the blessings of Ildraha be with you all..."{w}
note: Blessing phrased as in pilot row 372.

en: "Then I can't perform the rite..."{w}
The castle is silent.{w}If you linger here any longer, you'll be taken for intruders.{w}It would be better to come back during the day.{w}
When you told the guards you had come about the Proclamation, they showed you to the audience chamber.{w}
note: Source literally 'had seen the Proclamation and come' -> 'had come about the Proclamation'.

en: The audience chamber is already crowded with adventurers.{w}The girls you saw at the inn earlier seem to be here too.{w}
note: [JP] 'girls' is the source's own word (Electra and company from the inn scene, pilot rows 240-285).

en: "Hello.{w}Sorry you had to see that embarrassing scene earlier.{w}I'm Electra. Nice to meet you."{w}
note: 'that embarrassing scene earlier' = the stable squabble with Mig at Zeppo's Inn (pilot rows 241-285).

en:
"They treat me like a horse here too!
Algrantz is a rude city full of rude people!"{w}
"Oh, let it go already.{w}...I wonder if unicorns are rare?{w}Everyone treats Mig like a horse."{w}
note: First sentence is to Mig, then Electra muses to the party; 'Mig' named instead of a pronoun (gender unknown).

en:
While you were chatting, the entrance doors opened.
You heard the guards snap to attention.{w}Soon, one of the guards came up right in front of you.{w}
Guard

"King Balgert will arrive shortly!"{w}{p}"We are also joined, from the Star Capital Lumisthenes, by the fortune-teller Natori and by Mayleen of the Stargazing Lighthouse!"{w}{p}"All of you, mind your manners!
No idle chatter!"{w}
note: [JP] on Natori/Mayleen not rendered as Lady/Lord (genders unknown in glossary); the guard's formal register carries the respect. [JP] = 'Stargazing Lighthouse' (new term).

en: Then, with a ringing of steel, the king appeared, clad in golden armor.{w}
The fortune-tellers followed.{w}
The two at the back don't seem to be from this city.{w}Amid the murmuring around you, you can make out the word 'Lumisthenes.'{w}
"What? This is all that showed up?"{w}
"Fewer and fewer come each time, it seems."{w}
note: 'each time': the Proclamation summons has been held repeatedly (pilot row 170 'again').

en:
"Can't be helped...{w}Waitin' around ain't gonna bring in any more,
so let's just get this started."{w}
note: Balgert's rough [JP] speech rendered with light dropped g's / ain't; keep consistent in later Balgert rows.

en:
"The name's Balgert.
I'm king of this here fortress city, Algrantz."{w}{p}"...Look at you, all scruffy and grubby.{w}Just like me when I was young! Hahaha!"{w}{p}"I called you all here for one reason and one reason only.{w}To help take back the Palace of the Sun!"{w}{p}"Now, the Palace of the Sun, see...{w}

{0E}"Now, the Palace of the Sun, see...{0F}
It's... uh... that thing...{w}It's all shiny and glowin'... and it's a palace..."{w}{p}"Basically, it's huge... and real tall...{w}

{0E}"Basically, it's huge... and real tall...{0F}
Natori! You explain it to 'em!"{w}
"Huh? Oh, right, right."{w}
"Hi, everyone, nice to meet you!"{w}{p}"I'm Natori, from the Temple of Rafa in Lumisthenes. Let's get along!{w}And this grumpy-looking one here is Ms. Mayleen!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Temple of Rafa' (pilot row 1). [JP] is the source's own honorific for a (learned) woman, rendered 'Ms.'; flag for glossary gender of Mayleen (still 'unknown' there).

en: "......{w}Enough of this nonsense. Get to the point, would you?"{w}
"Aww, what? I was trying to liven things up...{w}...Tch."{w}
"Ahem. Well then, let's start over."{w}
"I'm going to give you all a quick rundown of the crisis we're facing right now."{w}

"Since ancient times, this land has prospered under the light of the Palace of the Sun, high up in the heavens."{w}{p}"The sun god Rafa dwells in the Palace of the Sun, shining a purifying light that protects this land from the Kin of Darkness."{w}{p}"We people of Lumisthenes have prayed every single day, keeping watch over how Rafa is faring. But, you see..."{w}{p}"That Palace of the Sun has now fallen into the hands of the Kin of Darkness."{w}
note: [JP] = 'the Dark Kin' (new term; 83 occurrences corpus-wide, needs a glossary entry). [JP] rendered plain 'Rafa' (no Lord/Lady: gender unknown). 'keeping watch over how Rafa is faring' = literally inquiring after Rafa's condition.

en:
"With the Palace of the Sun in the hands of the Kin of Darkness, all sorts of effects are starting to show across the land."{w}{p}"The purifying light has gone murky, and the power that protects the land is fading away."{w}{p}"Lately the Kin of Darkness have been showing up more often and getting more vicious than usual,
and that's probably why."{w}

"Recently, we sent envoys to the rulers of every land to inform them of the situation at the Palace of the Sun, and received several proposals for breaking the deadlock."{w}{p}"From King Balgert of Algrantz, we received a proposal to revive the legendary 'Stairway of Light' and storm the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"The Stairway of Light is..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Stairway of Light' (new term). [JP] -> 'rulers of every land' (neutral).

en:
"How about that!
Pretty good idea, don'tcha think!?"{w}{p}"The legendary Palace of the Sun, reached by the legendary Stairway of Light!{w}Go on, Mayleen, keep it goin'!!"{w}
"......I shall continue."{w}

"The Stairway of Light is the stairway Rafa is said to have used when ascending to the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"We were aware of the legend that it lies in Konnu, but its existence has yet to be confirmed."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Konnu' (new name; dungeon [JP] = Konnu Grassland Ruins in DGN_NAME). Subject of 'were aware' (unstated) taken as 'we' (Lumisthenes), matching row 622's 'we sent envoys'.

en: "So that's why you've all been called here.{w}We in Lumisthenes will cooperate in every way we can to get this situation under control, too."{w}
"We will now hand out compasses for finding the site where the Stairway of Light once stood -- in other words, the 'Lightstair Ruins.'"{w}
note: [JP]: coined word with a reading gloss; the gloss is dropped in English. 'Lightstair Ruins' (16 chars) chosen to fit ITEM_PRIZ.CSV:4 compass-target name (max 18) -- the camp menu label must use the same string (rows 635 and slice_09+).

en: "Normally, you'd have to come to Lumisthenes for us to give a compass its power, you know?"{w}{p}"But today, we've prepared them specially.{w}So take one home with you!"{w}
A compass was placed in each of your hands.{w}
"Hahaha!!{w}You lot, this compass is somethin' else, y'know!?"{w}{p}"This compass, see...{w}

{0E}"This compass, see...{0F}
The compass... it's... uh... that thing...{w}
"Why, I have been explaining it all along, have I not?"{w}
note: Mayleen already explained the compass (row 627); dry put-down.

en: "Uh, r-right..."{w}

"Now then, everyone.{w}I will say this only once, so listen carefully."{w}{p}"Once you enter the ruins at Konnu, the first thing to do is set up camp."{w}{p}"In camp, be sure to set your compass's search target to the 'Lightstair Ruins.'"{w}{p}"If there are any clues nearby, the light should point you to where they are."{w}

"The light changes color depending on how far you are from what you're looking for."{w}{p}"Red means you're in the wrong place entirely.{w}Blue means it's the right place but the wrong floor.{w}Yellow means it's right nearby!"{w}
"You can turn off the compass's light by setting the search target to 'None.'{w}Feel free to turn it off whenever you don't need it."{w}
note: 'None' ([JP]) must match the camp compass menu label once the UI is translated.

en:
"And that's the briefing!
Don't worry, with this many people we'll manage somehow.{w}Good luck!!"{w}
"There is one more item being issued.{w}That would be this: the Angel's Window.{w}A handy device that shows you your surroundings."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Angel's Window' (proposed item name, ITEM.CSV 460, max 16; automap gem).

en: "We've got plenty, so no need to rush. Line up in two rows in front of us, okay?"{w}
You took your place at the back of the line. Electra's group was lined up just ahead of you.{w}
"I was going to start by hunting down the ore to make an Angel's Window myself, but they're handing them out? How generous."{w}
note: New item name: Angel's Window (ITEM.CSV 460, max 20).

en: Natori and Mayleen began handing out the Angel's Windows one by one.{w}
note: te-watashi = handed over personally, rendered "one by one".

en: "Here you go."{w}
"...Would you be so kind as to hold out your hand?"{w}
note: Mayleen's ojou-sama politeness; she gets curter with each adventurer (645 > 647 > 649).

en: "Here, good luck!"{w}
"...Hold out your hand."{w}
"Mayleen, smile, smile!"{w}

note: o-te = the command for a dog to give its paw; "Paw." keeps the dog-command joke.

en: "Ah, she's in a bad mood, but don't let it bother you.{w}I'm gonna hand these out nice and fast!{w}Here, here, and here... Huh?"{w}
note: sono hito (Mayleen) rendered "that one" to avoid a pronoun; Mayleen's gender is not in the glossary. | ED: glossary now lists Mayleen as female; 'that one' (pronoun dodge) -> 'she'.

en: "Is something the matter?"{w}
"...We've run out of Angel's Windows!"{w}
The Angel's Windows ran out right in front of you and Electra.{w}
note: zaiko = stock; "ran out" covers it.

en: "How odd.{w}We should have prepared more than enough..."{w}
"Ah. Uh-oh."{w}
"'Uh-oh'? Don't tell me you..."{w}
"N-no! It's nothing!{w}What'll I do, this is a real pickle... Ahaha..."{w}
"Are there any materials left?{w}If you have Dvel Soft Steel and Frozen Elven Iron, I can make them myself..."{w}
note: New item names: Dvel Soft Steel (doveru nankou, ITEM.CSV 434), Frozen Elven Iron (hyouka eruben tetsu, ITEM.CSV 437). Both max 20 incl. "+2".

en: "Ooh, how reliable! I'll have someone look for some.{w}
note: Sentence continues in the echo row 660 (opening quote left open, as in the source).

en:
{0E}"Ooh, how reliable! I'll have someone look for some.{0F}
Hey, King Balgert. Got any ore?"{w}
note: Balgert-sama rendered "King Balgert" (Natori's casual nee + honorific). {0E}..{0F} repeats row 659 verbatim.

en: "Hmph! We've got that stuff coming out of our ears!{w}As for where it is... er...{w}
note: kusaru hodo aru = so much it rots; idiom swapped for an English one of the same force.
Echo of 661 with its {w} turned into \n, as the source does. One guard answers and leaves, so singular.

en: "As you command!!"{w}
note: Avoided "sir" (Balgert's gender is not in the glossary).

en: The guard scurried out of the room.{w}
"I have brought the Dvel Soft Steel and Frozen Elven Iron!"{w}
"Good, hand it over to 'em!!"{w}

"Thank goodness.{w}If I combine these two through alchemy, it should make an Angel's Window."{w}{p}"You should all find an alchemist friend too, and have them make one in the Alchemy Storage at the inn from earlier."{w}
note: gousei renkin = alchemical combination. renkin souko = "Alchemy Storage" (new UI term; HELP_TEXT 166). sakihodo no yadoya = the inn where the party met Electra (Zeppo's Inn) -- kept vague as in source.

en: "Why are you telling these guys!?{w}They're our rivals!"{w}
"None of that, now. When someone's in a bind, we help each other out."{w}
note: komatta toki wa otagai-sama.

en:
"All right, all right!
Everyone's got a compass and an Angel's Window now, yeah?{w}...And you two groups there, you're fine too, since you got the materials, right?"{w}
note: sono futakumi = the player party and Electra's party.

en: "Yes. Thank you for your kindness."{w}
"Me, I'm a king built for wartime.{w}My policy is to leave the complicated stuff to the scholars and the spellcasters."{w}{p}"In return, I won't get in your way! Go at it all you want!"{w}
"With that, you're dismissed!!{w}Once you've managed to find the Lightstair Ruins, come report to me here in the audience chamber!"{w}
note: hikari no kaiseki: coined word (kaidan + ato, "site of the stairway", glossed by Mayleen in row 627). Rendered "Stairway Ruins of Light" to pair with "Stairway of Light" (hikari no kaidan). Must be unified with slice_08.

en: "I'm expecting good news!{w}Nwahahahaha!!"{w}
With a booming laugh, King Balgert left the audience chamber.{w}
"Well then, we'll head back into town.{w}Let's both pray for a safe journey."{w}
note: otagai no tabi no buji = each other's safe journeys.

en: Electra and Mig left the room.{w}Only a scattering of adventurers remained.{w}
"By the way, Natori."{w}
"Urk!"{w}
note: giku = a guilty start, spoken aloud.

en: "I had my suspicions.{w}...You sold off the supplies again, didn't you?"{w}
"T-ten of them... or so..."{w}
"Sigh..."{w}
"But the dealer was being mean to me, okay!?{w}And it's not like I was cheating!!"{w}
note: dealer = gambling dealer; Natori sold the stock to fund gambling (implied by source, not stated).

en: "I suppose this must be reported to the Council Chair."{w}
note: gichou = chairperson of an assembly; "Council Chair" is gender-neutral. Identity unknown (possibly Wattner, row 723 -- not verified). New term.

en: "Uuuu..."{w}
note: eu- = whimper.

en: Natori was all but dragged out by Mayleen.{w}{p}You decided to leave the audience chamber as well.{w}
You came to the audience chamber, but you still haven't found the 'Lightstair Ruins.'{w}
note: PROOF: period moved inside the quote, matching 627.

en: When you told them you had found the Lightstair Ruins, the guards went to fetch King Balgert.{w}{p}After a while, King Balgert appeared, all smiles.{w}
"I heard, you lot! You found it, didn't you!!{w}Good work, good work!!{w}So, how do we make the Stairway of Light appear!?"{w}
You explained about the hollows in the three altars.{w}
note: kubomi = hollows/recesses (sockets for the stones).

en: "Huh? Three altars and hollows?{w}Never heard of any such thing.{w}...No, wait a sec."{w}{p}"Maybe you mean the Three Phantom Stones? The Hemaid Red Stone, the Green Plakio and the Blue Menon?"{w}{p}"They're the three shining magic stones that come up in the legend of the Stairway of Light."{w}
note: New terms: sangenseki = "Three Mystic Stones", genseki = "Mystic Stones"; Hemaid Red Stone (hemaido no akaishi). Green Plakio / Blue Menon from pilot rows 3-4.

en: "If they've gone missing, that's a job for the compass."{w}{p}"Go see Natori, and have the compass imbued with the power to search for the Three Phantom Stones."{w}

"Natori's at the Temple of Rafa in Lumisthenes.{w}I've got other business in Lumisthenes myself.{w}It's about time I got ready for it."{w}{p}"You lot go about it however you like. Once you've got the Three Phantom Stones, come back here!{w}I'll be waiting for good news!!"{w}
note: Temple of Rafa as in pilot row 1.

en: "What, you still haven't been to Lumisthenes?{w}It's the Temple of Rafa, don't get it wrong, okay?"{w}{p}"Or are you gonna tag along behind me?{w}Nwahahahaha!"{w}

note: shikkari x2 kept as a repeated phrase.

en: You showed the Hemaid Red Stone to Balgert.{w}
note: Full-width space after the item name in source (item-name padding) dropped.

en: "Huh? What's that pebble?{w}...Wait, isn't that the Hemaid Red Stone!?{w}Lemme see!"{w}{p}"...Right.{w}This is... uh...{w}It's red!!"{w}
"Good job, you lot!!"{w}
You showed the Green Plakio to Balgert.{w}
"...What, that's the Green Plakio?{w}Smells kinda fishy to me...{w}Isn't it just an emerald?"{w}{p}"Lemme borrow that a sec.{w}Aaaah..."{w}
note: a-n = opening the mouth wide (to bite it), set up by row 701.

en: Balgert snatched the Green Plakio from you and popped it straight into his mouth!{w}
note: "the royal mouth" avoids a possessive pronoun for Balgert (gender not in glossary); source just says "into the mouth". | ACC: "the royal mouth" was an addition; glossary now lists Balgert as male, so plain "his mouth" as in the source ("into the mouth").

en: "Gwoh!?{w}Th-thish ish harrrrd...!?"{w}{p}"M-my teefh... fhought fey'd shnapped...{w}Hah, fhish might be fhe real fing!"{w}{p}"Goob jobh, you lomph!!"{w}
note: Mouth-full mumbling. Decoded source: "ha, ha ga oreccatta ka to... aa, korya honmono kamo shirenee na! ... yoku yatta zo, omeera!!" = "My t-teeth, I thought they'd broken... ah, this might be the real thing! ... Good job, you lot!!". English garbled to stay decodable.

en: "Ahh, but still, I just can't find the Blue Menon...{w}What am I supposed to do, jeez?"{w}
note: ED: mattaku -> 'jeez' (Balgert's rough register; 'honestly' is Gia's tic in this file).

en: You showed the Blue Menon to Balgert.{w}

"Yeah, it's a blue thing, kinda like this,
it's all Menon-y, and the Menon's...{w}
note: Balgert rambling; sentence continues in echo row 706.

en: "What're you lot playing at? Great job!!"{w}
note: nani shiten da = mock-reproach turned praise; kept the comic turn.

en: "Mm, good, you're on a roll!{w}We've got the army out searching too, but keep riding this momentum and carry on with your investigation!"{w}
"Oh, so you've finally got all the Phantom Stones!{w}You lot are amazing!!"{w}{p}"And the army, by comparison... jeez.{w}You bunch are a disgrace, you hear me!?"{w}
note: Second "omeera" is aimed at the soldiers (the soldier apologizes in 710); "And the army" signals the switch. | ED: the second address (omeera, at the soldiers) said 'You lot', the same words used for the party a page earlier, so it read as scolding the party -> 'You bunch'. mattaku -> 'jeez' as in 703.

en: "We're sorry!"{w}
note: Soldier apologizing for the army; "we" chosen since Balgert scolds the army as a group.

en: "Eh, never mind!"{w}{p}"Right then, put the Phantom Stones back in the Lightstair Ruins and make the stairway appear.{w}We're all taking back the sun together!!"{w}{p}"Hey, send letters to the Council Chair, Rianna and the rest.{w}Tell 'em: 'The Stairway of Light is back!'"{w}
note: gichou ya Rianna-tachi = the Chair and Rianna's people. | ACC: gichou ya Rianna-tachi = the Chair, Rianna and others; letters go to Rianna herself, not only "her people".

en: "Understood!"{w}
"...No, hang on a sec.{w}Just on the one going to Roscadil, add a 'Niiin!' at the end."{w}
note: ni-n! is a silly sound with no fixed meaning (a teasing tag for Roscadil); romanized rather than given an invented meaning.

en: "Er, uh...? As you command, but..."{w}
"Yeah, I'm counting on you! Heh heh heh!"{w}
"Riiight then, put the Phantom Stones back in the Lightstair Ruins and make the stairway appear.{w}We're all taking back the sun together!!"{w}
note: Repeat-visit version of the 711 instruction; wording kept identical apart from the opener.

en: "Never thought I'd be told I'm not qualified.{w}I'm ashamed of myself...{w}I'm the king, and I'm not even qualified to bring back peace..."{w}{p}"I'm sorry. All I can do is leave it to you lot.{w}Sorry about this..."{w}
note: Who judged Balgert unqualified is not stated here (later story); kept the passive.

en: "Well, when you come home safe, I'll throw you one heck of a celebration!{w}We'll drink and sing and party like crazy! Right!?"{w}
"You lot did good."{w}
When you went inside, you were showered with praise.{w}
"Congratulations! That's amazing!{w}You really went to the Palace of the Sun and came back victorious!{w}You did it!"{w}
note: [JP] has no stated object; rendered 'came back victorious' rather than inventing who was defeated.

en: "Congratulations...{w}No -- rather than that, I suppose I should be saying thank you."{w}
Wattner
note: New name [JP], romanized Wattner (not in glossary). Gender unknown.

en: "You have done splendidly.{w}This is all thanks to your courage and your drive.{w}...With this, we can rest easy, for now at least."{w}
"Here's your reward. Take it."{w}

As a reward, you received
1,000,000 GP.{w}
"Right, enough of the stuffy talk!{w}Let's go have ourselves a victory parade!"{w}
"Hey! So you lot made it back!{w}I've put you through a lot of trouble, too."{w}
"But now you're big heroes yourselves.{w}How's it feel?{w}Well, it's all thanks to me, of course! Gahahaha!"{w}

"By the way, aren't you curious
what's become of the Palace of the Sun?"{w}{p}"I've got a feeling something's still going on there...{w}So, would you do me a favor?"{w}{p}"Go take a look at the Palace of the Sun for me.{w}If there's nothing there, that's fine."{w}
"Well, I'm counting on you."{w}
"Hey! You lot doing all right?{w}What're you here for, after betraying me like that?{w}Nwahahahaha!!"{w}
note: [JP] kept as a joking accusation (he laughs right after); which betrayal it refers to is not visible in this slice.

en: "Hey, you lot. How are things going?"{w}

note: [JP] = 'Sun Spirit' (new term). [JP] = 'that bunch' (the known enemy faction, unnamed here).

en:
"Bright! Way too bright!{w}So the Sun Spirit's doing better, huh?{w}Isn't it too bright now, though?"{w}{p}"Well, as long as the Sun Spirit's healthy, that's fine by me.{w}You lot really did a whole lot for us.
Thanks!"{w}{p}"On behalf of everyone, you have my thanks."{w}
"Rianna was looking for you, y'know."{w}{p}"Go on over to Roscadil."{w}
"Fulgrant was looking for you, y'know."{w}{p}"Go on over to Ogre Bay."{w}

en:
"Someone from Perpeco Village was looking
for you, y'know."{w}{p}"Go on over to Perpeco Forest."{w}

"You carve out your own path -- that's what an adventurer is.{w}If you're ready to carry your own life on your back,
sign up on this roster!"{w}

note: Source has no closing quote; kept without one. [JP] (Fena's sound-word habit) -> 'ZOOM'. | PROOF: closing quote added (missing in source; 742 opens a new quote, so not a continuation).

en:
"Hey, you guys! How's it going?
Up for a bit of retraining?"{w}

note: Fena's onomatopoeia teaching rendered with invented English sound words; the illogic (three moves -> 'two') is in the source. Last page has no closing quote; it continues in row 744.
{0E}..{0F} part repeats the last page of row 743 verbatim.
ED: kyoukan = Fena speaking of herself; 'their instructor' read as someone else -> 'I' (accuracy item 4).

en:
"Hey, how's it going?{w}There's something I'd like to ask of you,
if that's okay?"{w}{p}"'Send me more adventurers!'{w}King Balgert keeps rushing me like that.{w}...Well, if the King's asking, I can't really say no."{w}{p}"But there just aren't enough instructors for all the trainees...{w}And you guys are busy with your adventures, right?
It's not like I can ask you to be instructors."{w}{p}"So, anyway, you know Abi, right?{w}Yep, yep -- the one that's just right for beginners.{w}Could you bring Abi over here for me?"{w}{p}"I think Abi would make a great sparring partner.{w}If you could just whoosh Abi over here with summoning
magic, I'll take care of the rest. Please!"{w}
note: Abi has no glossary gender; phrased with the name, no pronoun. [JP] -> 'King Balgert' ([JP] rendered King, used as a title; no he/she used for Balgert anywhere in the slice).

en:
"Think of it as helping out your juniors. Please!
Besides, if they head out on adventures half-trained,{w}you know what'll happen to them... right?"{w}

"Yay! That's my guys!{w}Abi, looking forward to working with you!
I'll give you a nice SHWAAA polish now and then!"{w}
"Thank you guys too. You really helped me out.{w}
note: No closing quote in source; continues in row 750.

en:
{0E}"Thank you guys too. You really helped me out.{0F}
...This is just something I took on myself, but...{w}do you know how King Balgert got that scar on his forehead?"{w}
note: [JP] read as Fena's self-appointed mission explained in rows 756-758 (protecting people/training in the King's place). Could also refer to the Abi favor. 'that scar on the forehead' avoids a pronoun. | ED: glossary now lists Balgert as male; pronoun dodge removed. Echo span untouched.

en:
"This was back when I was a kid, playing outside the city walls...
Even though Mom had told me not to go out there.{w}And then a monster attacked me..."{w}{p}"Just when I thought, 'This is it, I'm done for...'{w}...the King appeared."{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'the King' throughout Fena's story (rows 751-760) to avoid a gendered pronoun; Fena's fondness carried by tone instead.

en: "Why would a king even be out in a place like that?{w}And guess what he was equipped with?{w}Bare fists. Bare fists! ...Honestly, what a fool."{w}
note: ED: ano hito -> 'he' (Balgert male per glossary); 'the King' repeated in every line of the story was stiff. First mention in 751 stays 'the King'.

en:
"I bet he'd snuck out to skip his royal duties.{w}...Well, with a personality like his...
...he probably doesn't even remember me, huh."{w}
note: ACC: subject restored (watashi no koto nante oboetenai = the King does not remember me); passive dropped the rememberer. | ED: ano hito -> 'he'/'his' (Balgert male per glossary).

en:
"...It was so cool.{w}This huge shadow came WHOOSHING in, and then:
'I'll not let you lay one finger on my people!'"{w}{p}"And then, with a fist -- KA-BLAM!{w}
note: Quoted royal line uses [JP] (old/kingly 'I'); rendered with a slightly archaic 'I'll not'. Last page has no closing quote; continues in row 755.

en:
{0E}"And then, with a fist -- KA-BLAM!{0F}
...That's where that scar came from."{w}
note: ED: 'came to be' was stiff for Fena's casual voice. Echo span untouched.

en:
"It was pure chance that I was the one who got saved.{w}But I think he'd save anyone at all,
and I bet he still feels that way even now."{w}{p}"But a king can't act -- it'd start a war.{w}So I'll protect lots of people in the King's place.{w}
note: Last page has no closing quote; continues in row 757. | ED: ano hito -> 'he'; subject restored in the second clause (hazu = 'I bet'). Last page (echoed by 757) untouched.
[JP] = Fena together with the trainees/party; rendered 'all of us'. | ED: ano hito -> 'he' (the King is named two sentences earlier). Echo span untouched.

en: "It's a promise I made to him that day, all on my own.{w}Sorry for dragging you into something like that, okay?"{w}{p}"But my training's been useful, right?"{w}
note: ED: 'made with ... all on my own' contradicted itself; ano hito to no yakusoku -> 'a promise I made to him'.

en: {0E}    *  Custom face icons are now unlocked  *    {0F}{w}
note: System notice: full-width centring spaces replaced by ASCII spaces.

en:
"With a floppy stance like that,
King Balgert's gonna laugh at you!
Plant your feet with more THUNK! THUNK!"{w}{p}"The King protects this country,
so you get strong too, and protect
the people weaker than you!"{w}{p}"That's how you repay the favor!"{w}
Branon
Chirocco

"Mmf, nngh... This cake is quite something!
As expected of that patissier............?{w}
note: No closing quote in source; continues in row 764. Branon's speech: [JP]/[JP]/misused [JP]/[JP] rendered as pompous 'so it is', a recurring misplaced tag 'would you suppose', and 'you chaps' (the [JP] lisp itself is not reproduced).
ED: misused de arou ka is rendered with Branon's tag 'would you suppose' everywhere else; 'one wonders' broke the tic.

en: "*Gulp*... I am Executor Branon, so I am.{w}And I am on duty... *munch*{w}Now, if you will excuse me. Nom, munch..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Executor' (new title, Roscadil state official). Draft; could also be 'Enforcement Officer'.

en: "Ohh, what flavor this is!"{w}
"Mmf, nom... This town has grown prosperous indeed.{w}This baked treat! The contrast in texture between outside and inside...!{w}
note: No closing quote in source; continues in row 768.

en: "No one dies for lack of sweets.{w}But that is precisely the point, so it is."{w}
"I, as an Executor of the state, thus... mmf...{w}partake of the people's sweets... nngh... and take their measure.{w}Now, if you will excuse me. Nom, munch..."{w}
note: Trailing space before the closing quote kept as in source. | PROOF: trailing space before closing quote removed (carried over from a full-width space), matching 765.

en:
"A lack of variety leads to
poverty of the heart, so it does... Hmm...{w}Something must be done about this grave state of affairs..."{w}

"...What do you chaps think this town is
lacking?{w}I believe it is new sweets, would you suppose."{w}

"You chaps! I have a request, so I do!{w}Bring me the most outlandish sweet you can find,
one nobody has ever eaten, would you suppose!"{w}

"Yes, and for outlandish, there is Joker Land!{w}Surely there will be sweets there
that even I have never tasted, would you suppose!"{w}{p}"Go! You are adventurers, so you aaare!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Joker Land' (new place name).

en:
"Ohh, well done!
Just as I expected of you chaps -- I had my eye on you, would you suppose!"{w}
note: Branon says [JP] here instead of his usual [JP]; invisible in English. | ED: garden-path relative clause untangled; Branon's tag kept.

en:
"This is...
a sweet that even I have never seen before...{w}Then, without delay... *chomp*... mmf...!?"{w}
"......................................!{w}Delicious! How utterly exquisite it is!{w}This taste! This aroma! Magnificent!"{w}
"I must take this sweet to the patissier at once... Ahh!{w}
note: No closing quote in source; continues in row 781.

en:
{0E}"I must take this sweet to the patissier at once... Ahh!{0F}
I have eaten it all already! A blunder, so it is!{w}Mmmh... Joker Land is not to be underestimated..."{w}
note: ED: Branon speaks without contractions (no-de-aru register) everywhere else.
[JP]: Branon offers to handle the party's business at the palace (likely unlocks a feature).

en:
"Mmf, nngh... Ohh, it's you chaps!
Care for one, would you?"{w}
"Ah! Watch your step there!{w}
note: Speaker ????; row 786 shows it is Chirocco. No closing quote; continues in row 786.

en:
{0E}"Ah! Watch your step there!{0F}
Sorry about that, I only just planted some seedlings.{w}Maybe I really should put up a fence or something..."{w}

"I'm the gardener here at Wells Garden.
The name's Chirocco.{w}I'm usually working somewhere around here."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Wells Garden' (new place name).

en: "Whoa there!{w}

{0E}"Whoa there!{0F}
...You okay? Didn't get splashed with water, did you?"{w}
"Sorry, you just popped up out of nowhere... Or were you here all along?{w}My bad, I was so wrapped up in my work."{w}

"Pretty, isn't it?{w}You can't get a garden looking like this
unless you really lose yourself in it."{w}

"Maybe it's partly 'cause I'm an elf, but
looking after plants is just fun for me... Haha."{w}
note: Chirocco states being an elf here.

en:
"Hey, have you guys been well?
What do you think? Pretty as ever, right?{w}The plants are as lively as always, anyway."{w}

Chirocco led you to a spot where
a small sapling sat, not yet planted.{w}
"This is the one.{w}Could you come a bit closer?"{w}

As you come close to the sapling,
a strange voice echoes in your heads.{w}
Sapling
